milestones.claim: verification_run command executes a pinned verifier and stamps a receipt in one step
milestones.doneMeans: lattice verification_run --intentRef resolves the pin, runs it via the shared enforceAndStampEvidence, writes a mechanical receipt on pass, refuses on no-pin; result derived from the receipt not the caller

milestones.claim: stale-evidence refresh re-executes the pinned command and re-issues a real receipt (or leaves demoted)
milestones.doneMeans: verification_evidence_refresh_stale re-runs the pin through enforceAndStampEvidence and re-stamps a receipt bound to current material on continued pass; leaves demoted on failure/unavailable; coexists additively with B-3b88

milestones.claim: fail-open PreToolUse evidence-pin guard on both Claude and Codex hosts
milestones.doneMeans: verification_pin_guard_check denies a pin-mismatched evidence-write command and allows a match; Claude Bash shim + Codex real-shell-token hook wired fail-open; handler still refuses when hook bypassed

milestones.claim: RED-first mutation-killing smoke covering all three, registered in validate
milestones.doneMeans: the registered smoke prints PASS, drives all three through real entry points, mutation-kills, and is wired in lattice.config.json + package.json
